init.title: Assign persons
init.description:
Persons on the device: {persons}. Pick the matching Home Assistant person for each. Mapped values go to one device per person (e.g. sensor.john_weight). Persons appear here after the first measurement.

Consent codes (standard-profile scales only) as slot:code, e.g. 1:1234, 2:5678.
